trigger: User rebooted robot and reported SSH restored
scope: read-only host/container/source inspection and passive subscriptions to existing ROS sensor publishers

network.previous_failure_root_cause: unresolved; recovery after reboot does not identify cause

host.kernel_error_query: journalctl read-only query timed out after 5 seconds; no kernel-log conclusion

clock.status: large cross-host wall-clock mismatch; not corrected in this assessment
clock.caution: Do not subtract workstation and Pi wall times for freshness or alignment. Container shares the host clock; local relative ordering does not prove cross-host synchronization.

runtime.rmw: RMW_IMPLEMENTATION not explicitly set in inspected driver environment; an existing daemon selected rmw_fastrtps_cpp. Not a per-node runtime proof.
runtime.existing_autostart: ros2 launch bringup bringup.launch.py; launch includes controllers, sensors, apps, joystick and init pose; not restarted by this assessment
runtime.mcap: not present in visible plugin list or checked package/files; current recorder hardcodes mcap
runtime.use_sim_time: launch/config sources use false; runtime parameter reads from initial probe could not resolve nodes, so runtime value not verified

passive_probe.logging: rosout and external-library logging disabled; parameter services disabled on audit nodes
passive_probe.uid_causality: Matching driver UID and explicit ROS environment produced data after the first attempt did not; UID/shared-memory causality not isolated by a controlled experiment.
passive_probe.rate_caution: Receiver-side rates from one short simultaneous multi-topic Python probe. They are not native camera FPS or measured loss rates.
passive_probe.point_cloud: topic discovered by separate graph query; not subscribed by the passive audit script

rgb_snapshot.method: one frame from existing RGB ROS publisher, UID1000 passive subscriber; JPEG encoding only for local inspection
rgb_snapshot.web_snapshot_endpoint: Not validated: initial proxy-affected request returned 502; direct no-proxy request closed without a response. Do not confuse that result with the successful ROS capture.

source_provenance.running_loaded_python_modules: not inspected; installed source mapping is not proof of current in-memory imports
source_provenance.controller_node_copies: ros_robot_controller_node.py differs between src/driver and hx2 snapshot; use installed source mapping rather than assuming copies interchangeable
source_provenance.base_chain: Twist -> ROS MecanumChassis inverse kinematics -> four wheel rps targets -> MotorsState -> serial SDK
source_provenance.odom_raw: source integrates cached commands with wall-clock dt, does not integrate lateral position; not encoder odometry
source_provenance.servo_state: get_position returns sent-target cache; explicit bus-servo-position read path exists but was not invoked
source_provenance.watchdog: no explicit motor command timeout/watchdog or encoder feedback read found in inspected ROS/SDK sources; MCU firmware remains unverified

remaining_gates: synchronize and document clocks before aligned acquisition
calibrate camera optical transforms and depth units
map gripper joint naming/units and distinguish target cache from feedback
implement hardware-readonly adapter and integrity fixes
concurrent_workspace_changes: End-of-assessment git status showed additional uncommitted agent/recorder/setup/runtime-profile/hardware-readonly/launch changes absent at entry.
